title: P1.3 Database wrapper: pragmas + tx-wrapped mutations
description: Per plan §4 operational rules, patterns proven in storage/database.rs. Database::open(): create parent dirs; journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, busy_timeout=5s, foreign_keys=ON; run_migrations. Database::in_memory() for tests (zero disk). Mutations ALL inside one transaction including SINGLE-prompt upsert (bug we fix: only bulk was tx-wrapped). upsert_prompt: INSERT..ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE on prompts; delete+reinsert tags; delete+reinsert variables; delete+reinsert FTS row — atomically. get_prompt loads tags+variables. list_prompts_filtered(category,tag,featured). category_counts/tag_counts/prompt_count. search(query,limit): FTS5 MATCH with BM25 weights id=5,title=3,description=2,content=1,tags_text=2; NEGATE returned score for ranking (BM25 negative quirk, ); escape_fts_query applied before MATCH (special chars must never panic). get_meta/set_meta on meta table. Acceptance unit tests on in_memory(): roundtrip upsert/get with tags+variables preserved; FTS search ranking correct and escaped; side-effect assertions (FTS rows match prompts rows after every mutation).
notes: [2026-08-22 02:43:00 UTC] POLISH R2: Database struct exposes with_tx<T>(f: impl FnOnce(&Transaction) -> Result<T>) helper — the ONLY sanctioned mutation path; direct conn access behind pub(crate). FTS sync helper fts_sync(prompt_id) reused by upsert/delete so doctor rebuild and normal writes share one code path (drift class eliminated at source).

title: P1.4 JSONL atomic export/import
description: Per plan §4 rule 4 and §9 format. export: first line {"_meta":{version,count,exported_at,schema_version}} then one prompt per line EMBEDDING its variables AND aliases array ({"id","title","content","description?","category?","tags":[],"variables":[...],"aliases":[...]}); write to <path>.tmp, fsync, atomic rename; WINDOWS caveat: remove destination before rename. import: skip _meta lines (only treat first non-empty line as meta if it has _meta key), parse each line with per-line error context, modes --merge (upsert by id) and --replace (wipe tables + insert in ONE transaction), REJECT files whose schema_version > LATEST. Round-trip guarantee is a locked contract: export -> destroy DB -> import -> every prompt byte-identical incl aliases+variables restored. Acceptance tests: roundtrip byte-equal content, merge preserves unrelated existing prompts, replace wipes cleanly, corrupt line yields actionable error with line number.

title: P2.1 Resolution engine: exact/alias/prefix/FTS + ambiguity
description: Heart of pst, plan §5. storage/resolve.rs with decision order: (1) EXACT prompts.id==query; (2) ALIAS aliases.alias==query COLLATE NOCASE; (3) PREFIX over ids-union-aliases: exactly 1 -> hit, more -> AMBIGUOUS with candidates sorted use_count DESC then alpha; (4) FUZZY FTS BM25 top-k=8: top1 beats top2 by >=40% AND passes min-score floor -> hit with stderr notice, leading-but-not-decisive -> AMBIGUOUS scored candidates, none -> NOT_FOUND. Hits from steps 3-4 bump use_count+last_used_at in one tx. HARD RULE ambiguity policy: NEVER pick when unclear; candidates table to stderr plus {"error":"ambiguous","candidates":[...]} exit 1 — an agent silently receiving wrong content is the worst failure mode (plan invariant #2). Naming invariants enforced inside insert transaction: canonical id regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$; alias regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,199}$; alias must not equal ANY canonical id exact or case-insensitively (FOO vs foo forbidden since lookup is NOCASE); alias unique among aliases NOCASE; violations return alias_conflict/id_conflict. Race-free because check-and-insert share one tx under WAL single-writer. Acceptance: EXHAUSTIVE unit matrix — every branch of the decision tree, use_count tie-break behavior, all collision cases.
notes:
[2026-08-22 02:41:39 UTC] POLISH R1: fuzzy threshold constants pinned for testability — FUZZY_TOPK=8, FUZZY_DOMINANCE=1.40 (top1_score >= 1.40 x top2_score), FUZZY_MIN_SCORE floor exposed as const with default 0.5 normalized; prefix candidates capped at 10 in ambiguous payload to bound output size. All four constants unit-tested via table.
---
[2026-08-22 02:43:00 UTC] POLISH R2: ResolveOutcome enum pinned: Hit{id,source:Exact|Alias|Prefix|Fuzzy} | Ambiguous{candidates} | NotFound{query}; use_count bump ONLY for Prefix/Fuzzy hits (exact/alias are intentional, no signal). Candidates struct {id,title,score:f64,source} serialized identically in human table + JSON payload (one formatter, two renderers).

title: P2.2 Argv prescan for dynamic --VAR=value tokens

RESERVED-FLAG PRECEDENCE: names matching real flags (--json,--no-color) never become variables; --json=x is a hard error. Edge battery REQUIRED as tests: --FOO= empty value ok; --FOO=a=b keeps second equals; --foo=bar accepted but case-sensitive substitution will not match {{FOO}} — warn on stderr when name differs only by case from a declared variable; --A_B=123; shell-unquoted values arrive intact. Unknown names appearing nowhere -> stderr warning, never fatal (typo catcher). WHY separate bead: this is the most pain-prone surface; clap cannot declare arbitrary flags; CLI frameworks force hand-parsing here. Acceptance: edge battery green in isolation before any command consumes variables.
